# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Publish closed native-COPY stock benchmark evidence and its research boundary."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re
import shutil
import statistics

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013')
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-native-copy-debug'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('native_bench_publish_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


def hashes(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: hashes(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [hashes(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def archive(source, target):
    dump(target, dict(path=str(source), sha256=m.sha(source), text=source.read_text()))


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-native-copy-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
             commands=[], evidence={}, gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False)

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = load(B / 'main-fixed-history-comparator-review-root-v3/record.json')['commands'][0]['environment']

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=2 << 20, total_cap=16 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '435f0a4f00570a256db0283c6faef8387a7832f3'
        assert not run('status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        launch_path = B / 'main-native-copy-benchsh-launch-root-v1/record.json'
        launch = load(launch_path)
        supervisor_path = Path(launch['supervisor_result']['path'])
        assert m.sha(supervisor_path) == launch['supervisor_result']['sha256']
        supervisor = load(supervisor_path)
        prior = load(W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-first-gpu/summary.json')
        receipts = [launch_path, B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-supervisor-cpu-root-v3/record.json', supervisor_path]
        derivations = []
        F.mkdir()
        for path in receipts:
            data = load(path)
            assert data['passed'] and data['complete'] and not data['active']
            if path != supervisor_path:
                assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in data['commands'])
            else:
                assert all(c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in data['commands'])
                assert data['normal_quit']['normal_quit'] and not data['normal_quit']['fallback_signals']
                assert data['actual_copy_queue_selection']['flag'] == 1
                assert all(not v['faults'] for k, v in data.items() if k.startswith('kernel-'))
            target = F / 'receipts' / (path.parent.name + '.json')
            dump(target, hashes(data))
            derivations.append(dict(original_path=str(path), original_sha256=m.sha(path), public_sha256=m.sha(target)))
        result = Path(launch['upstream_result']['path'])
        assert m.sha(result) == launch['upstream_result']['sha256']
        target = F / 'upstream/results.json'
        target.parent.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(result, target)
        assert m.sha(target) == m.sha(result)
        archive(result.parent / 'README.md', F / 'upstream/README.md.json')
        for name in ('main-config.json', 'server-debug-copy1.json'):
            shutil.copyfile(launch_path.parent / name, F / name)
        packet = B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-supervisor-source-v3'
        for name in ('supervisor.py.txt', 'manifest.json', 'SHA256SUMS.txt', 'MAIN_EXTENSION.txt'):
            archive(packet / name, F / 'supervisor-source' / (name + '.json'))
        dump(F / 'supervisor-source/inherited-source.json', dict(
            unchanged_files=['mapping.py.txt', 'server-close-observer.py.txt', 'cpu-fixtures.py.txt'],
            prior_archive='../2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-first-gpu/supervisor-source',
            current_packet=str(packet), manifest_sha256=m.sha(packet / 'manifest.json')))
        for name in ('main-native-copy-benchsh-launch-v1.py', 'main-benchsh-supervisor-cpu-v3.py',
                     'main-benchsh-native-copy-publication-v1.py'):
            archive(B / name, F / 'controllers' / (name + '.json'))
        raw_engine = supervisor_path.parent / 'engine.log'
        lines = raw_engine.read_text().splitlines()
        startup_end = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.startswith('strata trace: request '))
        useful = lines[:startup_end] + [line for line in lines[startup_end:] if not line.startswith('strata trace: window ')]
        dump(F / 'engine-evidence.json', dict(path=str(raw_engine), sha256=m.sha(raw_engine),
            original_lines=len(lines), lines=useful, omitted='Only repeated successful per-token trace windows; runtime/fault checks retained'))
        journals = []
        for path in sorted(supervisor_path.parent.glob('kernel*.stdout')):
            if path.name != 'kernel-cursor.stdout':
                rows = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
                journals.append(dict(label=path.stem, total_rows=len(rows), sha256=m.sha(path),
                    retained=supervisor[path.stem], unrelated_rows_retired=True))
        dump(F / 'journal-evidence.json', dict(cursor=supervisor['kernel-before']['cursor'],
            windows=journals, filter_source_sha256=m.sha(packet / 'supervisor.py.txt')))
        report_names = ['research-native-copy-independent-issuer-safety-round346-v1.txt',
            'research-phase-cache-stock-bench-admission-round347-v1.txt',
            'research-prefill-scratch-precision-boundaries-round348-v1.txt',
            'research-recurrent-moe-activation-precision-evidence-round349-v1.txt',
            'research-gdn-y-kernel-consumer-alias-round350-v1.txt',
            'research-full-context-prefill-only-entry-round351-v1.txt',
            'implementation-phase-cache-stock-bench-v4.txt',
            'research-stock-bench-comparison-round352-v1.txt',
            'research-bench-quiet-admission-round353-v1.txt']
        report_pins = []
        for name in report_names:
            target = F / 'research' / (name + '.json')
            archive(B / 'research-20261009' / name, target)
            report_pins.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
        previous = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-first-gpu/report-registry-v182.json'
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v183.json', dict(research_completed=load(previous)['research_completed'] + len(report_pins),
            prior=dict(path='../2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-first-gpu/report-registry-v182.json', sha256=m.sha(previous)),
            new_reports=report_pins, main_only_test_execution=True))
        a = prior['result_assessment']['samples']
        b = launch['result_assessment']['samples']
        assert all(x['prompt_tokens'] == x['read_tokens'] == 32049 and x['reused_tokens'] == 0 and x['generated_tokens'] == 24 for x in a + b)
        med0 = statistics.median(x['prompt_tps'] for x in a)
        med1 = statistics.median(x['prompt_tps'] for x in b)
        dump(F / 'summary.json', hashes(dict(main_reviewed=True, benchmark_method='Unmodified upstream bench.sh --long --runs 3',
            source_revision=launch['source_revision'], upstream_revision=launch['upstream_revision'],
            binary_sha256=load(launch_path.parent / 'main-config.json')['binary_sha256'],
            mode='debug', performance_eligible=False, optimization_adopted=False,
            prior_report='../2026-10-13-upstream-benchsh-first-gpu', copy0_samples=a, copy1_samples=b,
            prefill_median_copy0=med0, prefill_median_copy1=med1,
            diagnostic_prefill_percent=100 * (med1 / med0 - 1),
            decode_decision='Separate; three 24-token continuations, COPY1 range 8.2 to 9.1; no sustained decode benefit established',
            normal_quit=launch['normal_quit'], no_fresh_gpu_faults=True, source_and_input_identities_unchanged=True,
            quiet_model_executed=False, quality_evaluated=False, full_physical262144_input_qualified=False,
            research_corrections=['R349 unused-y deletion rejected: kernels.cpp normalizer reads raw FP32 y; R350 supplies the missing consumer proof.',
                'qkv/y alias lowers GDN subregion only; actual max(GDN,QSA,MoE) may leave global allocation unchanged.',
                'R352 introductory v0.14.3 is a typo; the pinned upstream client is v0.1.43 / 7695859.'],
            phase_cache_status='Separate worktree actual source implemented, all build/test/GPU/quality unverified, Main validation pending; current measured binary unchanged',
            next_step='Run the same pristine stock suite in separate reviewed quiet COPY0/1 processes; judge phases separately. Validate new phase-cache source on Main before any GPU launch.')))
        for language, old, new in (
            ('ja', '入力トークン数と再利用数を確認する。32,768 トークン未満の試行は長文の採用判定から外し、\n結果自体は残す。短い入力や agent セッションの結果は補助結果として残す。',
             '入力トークン数と再利用数を確認する。上流の標準長文ケースを、同じモデルと同じ\nクライアントで比較する。実入力が 32,049 トークンならその数で記録し、32,768 以上の\n検証とは区別する。標準ケースの成功を、目標値を下回っただけで失敗に変えない。\n短い入力や agent セッションの結果は補助結果として残す。'),
            ('en', 'reused token counts rather than its label alone. Exclude samples below 32,768 tokens\nfrom long-input adoption decisions while retaining their results. Keep short-input\nand agent-session measurements as supporting results.',
             'reused token counts rather than its label alone. Compare the stock long-input case\nwith the same model and client. Record an actual 32,049-token input as that count,\nand distinguish it from testing at least 32,768 tokens. Missing the target count\nalone does not turn a successful stock case into a failed measurement. Keep\nshort-input and agent-session measurements as supporting results.')):
            path = W / 'docs' / ('MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.ja.md' if language == 'ja' else 'MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md')
            text = path.read_text()
            assert old in text
            path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
        (F / 'REPORT.md').write_text('''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Native COPY: pristine upstream bench.sh diagnostic

Both COPY0 and COPY1 completed upstream's unchanged v0.1.43 suite on Arc B570 /
Ryzen 5 5600X, with the same free binary b54579b and source 410904c. Command:
`bench.sh --url http://127.0.0.1:18095 --long --runs 3 --out DIR`.
Native IQ3_S, prefill 8192/group 16, cache 128 (144 effective slots), workers 5 /
tasks 18, no borrow/MTP/prompt reuse, int8 KV resident 32768/context 262144,
segmented verification, issuer 0, source-built DPC++ 7.1.1/UR Level Zero v2 and
DirectSubmission 0 were fixed. Only COPY selection changed between arms.
Both processes used validation and tracing: these are diagnostic timings.

| Run | Input/read | Reused | Output | COPY0 prefill | COPY1 prefill | COPY0 decode | COPY1 decode |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 32049 | 0 | 24 | 403.9 | 475.1 | 9.1 | 8.2 |
| 2 | 32049 | 0 | 24 | 400.5 | 477.3 | 8.7 | 9.1 |
| 3 | 32049 | 0 | 24 | 399.3 | 480.0 | 8.8 | 9.1 |

Rates are tok/s, all supplied by the engine through the upstream HTTP client.
Prefill medians are 400.5 and 477.3, a diagnostic increase of 19.18%; ranges are
399.3-403.9 and 475.1-480.0. Decode is assessed separately: the observed COPY1
range is 8.2-9.1, over only 24 generated tokens. No sustained decode benefit,
optimization adoption, quality result or objective completion is established.
The full upstream per-request artifact is copied byte-identically. Previous
raw-GEN results are not mixed with these HTTP measurements.

COPY1 selected the actual qualified copy-only group 1 before bench started.
Every request succeeded. The original server close wrote/flushed QUIT and both
engine and server exited zero without fallback signals. The anchored outer
owner reaped an empty session. Exact integer GPU health passed before and after;
all fresh kernel windows were fault-free, no devcoredump appeared, and source /
model / binary / provider identities remained unchanged. Five real CPU lifecycle
fixtures passed. No service, reset or device binding was changed.

The stock client's roughly-32K target produced 32,049 actual tokens. Workflow
guidance now compares this stock case by actual counts rather than imposing an
extra exact-32768 threshold that pristine calibration does not guarantee.
Historical receipts and their strict-threshold classifications remain immutable;
neither diagnostic arm is ranked. Separate 32768/64K/full physical 262144 claims
require their own actual evidence. Short suite stages and agent rows are auxiliary;
the persistent server's preceding suite stages warm allocations and graphs.

Nine new source reports are archived in registry v183 (881 completed reports).
Main rejected R349's unused-FP32-y deletion: the GDN normalization kernel reads
raw y, as R350 verifies. A qkv/y lifetime alias may reduce its subregion but may
save zero global bytes under the max-of-sets allocation; no change is adopted.
The phase-cache implementation exists in a separate worktree and has no build,
test, GPU or quality qualification. Its report's generic CUDA compiler suggestion
does not replace the machine's already qualified Intel-only contrib-llvm recipe.
Full-context probe coverage/finite/final-cell proof gaps remain open.

Next, execute matched quiet COPY0/1 stock suites from separate reviewed configs,
retain each long sample and judge prefill/decode separately. Main owns all new
phase-cache tests before GPU use. Successful per-token windows and duplicate
journal/console output are retired only after verified evidence extraction.
Original pinned receipts, individual upstream results and required fixtures stay.
''')
        dump(F / 'receipt-derivations.json', derivations)
        deletions = []
        for path in receipts:
            raw_paths = list((path.parent / 'commands').glob('*.stdout')) + list((path.parent / 'commands').glob('*.stderr'))
            if path == supervisor_path:
                raw_paths += list(path.parent.glob('*.stdout')) + list(path.parent.glob('*.stderr')) + [raw_engine]
            for raw in sorted(set(raw_paths)):
                if raw.is_file():
                    deletions.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=raw.stat().st_size, sha256=m.sha(raw),
                        reason='Closed successful run; individual metrics, progress, command outcomes, provider/health/fault and lifecycle evidence verified and retained'))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', dict(deletions=deletions, deleted=False,
            active_runs_touched=False, original_pinned_receipts_retained=True,
            owner='Main', consumer='Matched quiet stock bench.sh comparison', byte_budget=4 << 20,
            next_review='After matched quiet COPY comparison',
            retained=['Original individual upstream results', 'Pinned closed receipts', 'Executable supervisor and server configs'],
            free_space_claim=False))
        files = [str(path.relative_to(W)) for path in sorted(F.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()]
        files += ['docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.ja.md', 'docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md']
        assert 'skipped (' not in run('final-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        for entry in derivations:
            assert m.sha(entry['original_path']) == entry['original_sha256']
        assert m.sha(target_result := F / 'upstream/results.json') == launch['upstream_result']['sha256']
        assert load(target_result)['results']['failures'] == []
        for entry in deletions:
            assert m.sha(entry['path']) == entry['sha256']
        for entry in deletions:
            Path(entry['path']).unlink()
        retention = load(F / 'retention-manifest.json')
        retention.update(deleted=True, removed_file_count=len(deletions),
            removed_logical_bytes=sum(item['bytes'] for item in deletions))
        dump(F / 'retention-manifest.json', retention)
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', str(F.relative_to(W)), 'docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.ja.md', 'docs/MEASUREMENT_WORKFLOW.md'])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'test(bench): record native COPY stock benchmark diagnostics'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'feat/fixed-history-logits-comparator-20261013'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, removed_files=len(deletions),
            removed_logical_bytes=retention['removed_logical_bytes'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'removed_files', 'removed_logical_bytes')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
